title_vi: Thu thay đổi dữ liệu (CDC): đọc nhật ký thay vì hỏi bảng

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a partial clone of the source repository; git hash-object of the retrieved body matches the source-map blob. No source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: CDC biến thay đổi của một bảng CRUD thành luồng sự kiện.
Sự kiện CDC thường đi vào Kafka.
Bản sao đọc cũng nhận WAL từ bản chính.

claims.evidence: Debezium's features page and PostgreSQL connector page were read from a partial clone of debezium/debezium, and PostgreSQL 16 logicaldecoding.sgml from postgres/postgres; the decoded changes, the missed delete and the retained WAL were measured by the author, who ran logical decoding with test_decoding on PostgreSQL 16.15 on 2026-10-18. Debezium itself was not run.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered lesson.md (markdown-it, tables enabled, every <details> open, a 16 px page gutter) at each width: the page never scrolled sideways and the figure was scaled to the column; the smallest SVG font-size times that scale is the recorded minimum at 320 px. `python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser` measured every line of the figure in Chromium inside its box. Not GitHub, not a real phone and not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: Log-based CDC as implemented by Debezium captures all changes including deletes, needs no data-model change such as a last-updated column, avoids frequent polling, and can capture old record state depending on the database.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of debezium/debezium at commit a058ebb7e267b4010ee0f37c68f3f9f0c01c31af.

claims.claim_vi: The Debezium PostgreSQL connector takes a consistent snapshot the first time it connects, then streams changes through a replication slot using the pgoutput plug-in of PostgreSQL 10+; replication slots retain all WAL needed by Debezium even during outages, so they must be monitored for disk use; update events carry previous values only with REPLICA IDENTITY FULL.
claims.section: Overview; Configuring replication slot; update events
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of debezium/debezium at commit a058ebb7e267b4010ee0f37c68f3f9f0c01c31af.

claims.claim_vi: Replication slots know nothing about their consumers and prevent removal of required WAL and catalog rows even with no connection; in extreme cases this can force a shutdown to prevent transaction ID wraparound, so unneeded slots should be dropped.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of postgres/postgres at REL_16_STABLE commit 8e928803020e5b5694cde58e4851fce64ef9d520.

claims.claim_vi: If max_slot_wal_keep_size is -1 (the default), replication slots may retain an unlimited amount of WAL files; otherwise, if a slot's restart_lsn falls behind the current LSN by more than that size, the consumer using the slot may no longer be able to continue replication because required WAL files were removed.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of postgres/postgres at commit 8e928803020e5b5694cde58e4851fce64ef9d520.

claims.claim_vi: Measured on PostgreSQL 16.15: after updating row 1, deleting row 2 and inserting row 3, a query on updated_at returned rows 1 and 3 only, while the test_decoding slot returned the UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT; with REPLICA IDENTITY FULL the update carried old-key values; an unread slot held 61 MiB (pg_size_pretty, powers of 2) of WAL after one million inserts and 6712 bytes after reading and a checkpoint.
claims.verified_by: The author ran and measured this on 2026-10-18 with wal_level=logical.

claims.claim_vi: The source states: CDC identifies and captures changes from database transaction logs through a source connector, transforms them, publishes them to a message queue and a sink connector updates targets; Debezium with Kafka Connect is a popular solution; the source opens with an unsourced 90% statistic.

design_notes_vi: Bốn bước của một thay đổi, so thăm dò với đọc nhật ký bằng kết quả thử, ba điều cần nhớ về slot và giá trị cũ. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source's '90% of the world's data' opening has no source and is not used.
The source says users only handle the first step; the lesson adds the replication-slot WAL retention that operators must monitor, measured.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
